  1607	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.MemH1
  1608	  kind: definition
  1609	  summary: "MemH1 f :<=> f is in L^2(R^d) and there is g : R^d -> R^d in L^2 with HasWeakGradient f g; the real space H^1(R^d; R)."
  1610	  keywords: [sobolev, definition]
  1611	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1612	  status: reusable
  1613	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-weak-gradient-ae-unique
  1614	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.weakGradient_ae_unique
  1615	  kind: theorem
  1616	  summary: "If g1 and g2 are both weak gradients of f and both lie in L^2(R^d), then g1 = g2 almost everywhere."
  1617	  keywords: [weak-gradient, uniqueness]
  1618	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1619	  status: reusable
  1620	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-dil-l2
  1621	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.dilL2
  1622	  kind: definition
  1623	  summary: "dilL2 r f x := r^(d/2) * f(r x) (real power, smul for vector-valued f): the L^2 dilation U_r of the manuscript."
  1624	  keywords: [dilation, definition]
  1625	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1626	  status: reusable
  1627	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-rpow-half-sq
  1628	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.rpow_half_sq
  1629	  kind: theorem
  1630	  summary: "For r > 0, (r^(d/2))^2 = r^d (real power on the left, natural power on the right)."
  1631	  keywords: [real-power, dilation]
  1632	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1633	  status: internal
  1634	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-integral-jacobian
  1635	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.integral_jacobian
  1636	  kind: theorem
  1637	  summary: "For r > 0 and any G : R^d -> E (E a real normed space), int r^d * G(r x) dx = int G(y) dy (Bochner integrals; unconditional)."
  1638	  keywords: [change-of-variables, lebesgue-measure]
  1639	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1640	  status: reusable
  1641	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-integrable-jacobian-iff
  1642	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.integrable_jacobian_iff
  1643	  kind: theorem
  1644	  summary: "For r > 0 and G : R^d -> E, x -> r^d * G(r x) is Lebesgue integrable iff G is."
  1645	  keywords: [change-of-variables, integrability]
  1646	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1647	  status: reusable
  1648	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-mem-lp-dil-l2
  1649	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.memLp_dilL2
  1650	  kind: theorem
  1651	  summary: "For r > 0, if f : R^d -> E is in L^2 then dilL2 r f is in L^2."
  1652	  keywords: [dilation, lp-space]
  1653	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1654	  status: reusable
  1655	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-norm-dil-l2-sq
  1656	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.norm_dilL2_sq
  1657	  kind: theorem
  1658	  summary: "For r > 0 and all x, ||dilL2 r f x||^2 = r^d * ||f(r x)||^2."
  1659	  keywords: [dilation, norm]
  1660	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1661	  status: internal
  1662	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-integral-norm-dil-l2-sq
  1663	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.integral_norm_dilL2_sq
  1664	  kind: theorem
  1665	  summary: "For r > 0 and any f : R^d -> E, int ||dilL2 r f x||^2 dx = int ||f x||^2 dx."
  1666	  keywords: [dilation, isometry]
  1667	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1668	  status: reusable
  1669	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-has-weak-gradient-dil-l2
  1670	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.hasWeakGradient_dilL2
  1671	  kind: theorem
  1672	  summary: "For r > 0, if HasWeakGradient f g then HasWeakGradient (dilL2 r f) (x -> r * dilL2 r g x)."
  1673	  keywords: [weak-gradient, dilation]
  1674	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1675	  status: reusable
  1676	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-is-rayleigh-trial
  1677	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.IsRayleighTrial
  1678	  kind: definition
  1679	  summary: "Structure IsRayleighTrial V f g: f in L^2, g in L^2, HasWeakGradient f g, int f^2 = 1, and x -> V(x) f(x)^2 integrable."
  1680	  keywords: [rayleigh-quotient, definition]
  1681	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1682	  status: reusable
  1683	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-rayleigh-value
  1684	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.rayleighValue
  1685	  kind: definition
  1686	  summary: "rayleighValue V f g := (int V(x) f(x)^2 dx) - int ||g(x)||^2 dx."
  1687	  keywords: [rayleigh-quotient, definition]
  1688	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1689	  status: reusable
  1690	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-rayleigh-set
  1691	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.rayleighSet
  1692	  kind: definition
  1693	  summary: "rayleighSet V := { q | exists f g, IsRayleighTrial V f g and rayleighValue V f g = q }."
  1694	  keywords: [rayleigh-quotient, definition]
  1695	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1696	  status: reusable
  1697	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-rayleigh-rate
  1698	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.rayleighRate
  1699	  kind: definition
  1700	  summary: "rayleighRate V := Real.sqrt (sSup (rayleighSet V))."
  1701	  keywords: [rayleigh-quotient, rate]
  1702	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1703	  status: reusable
  1704	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-is-rayleigh-trial-mem-h1
  1705	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.IsRayleighTrial.memH1
  1706	  kind: theorem
  1707	  summary: "If IsRayleighTrial V f g then MemH1 f."
  1708	  keywords: [rayleigh-quotient, sobolev]
  1709	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1710	  status: reusable
  1711	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-rayleigh-value-indep
  1712	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.rayleighValue_indep
  1713	  kind: theorem
  1714	  summary: "If IsRayleighTrial V f g1 and IsRayleighTrial V f g2 then rayleighValue V f g1 = rayleighValue V f g2."
  1715	  keywords: [rayleigh-quotient, weak-gradient]
  1716	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1717	  status: reusable
  1718	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-is-rayleigh-trial-dil
  1719	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.IsRayleighTrial.dil
  1720	  kind: theorem
  1721	  summary: "For r > 0, if IsRayleighTrial V f g then (dilL2 r f, x -> r * dilL2 r g x) is a trial for x -> r^2 V(r x), with rayleighValue equal to r^2 * rayleighValue V f g."
  1722	  keywords: [rayleigh-quotient, dilation]
  1723	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1724	  status: internal
  1725	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-rayleigh-set-dil
  1726	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.rayleighSet_dil
  1727	  kind: theorem
  1728	  summary: "For every real potential V on R^d and r > 0, rayleighSet (x -> r^2 V(r x)) = r^2 . rayleighSet V (pointwise scaling of the set)."
  1729	  keywords: [rayleigh-quotient, dilation]
  1730	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1731	  status: reusable
  1732	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-sqrt-s-sup-scale
  1733	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.sqrt_sSup_scale
  1734	  kind: theorem
  1735	  summary: "For every set S of reals and r > 0, sqrt (sSup (r^2 . S)) = r * sqrt (sSup S)."
  1736	  keywords: [supremum, real-power]
  1737	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1738	  status: internal
  1739	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-s-sup-rayleigh-set-dil
  1740	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.sSup_rayleighSet_dil
  1741	  kind: theorem
  1742	  summary: "For every real potential V and r > 0, sSup (rayleighSet (x -> r^2 V(r x))) = r^2 * sSup (rayleighSet V)."
  1743	  keywords: [rayleigh-quotient, supremum]
  1744	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1745	  status: reusable
  1746	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/weak-sobolev-rayleigh-rate-dil
  1747	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WeakSobolev.rayleighRate_dil
  1748	  kind: theorem
  1749	  summary: "For every real potential V and r > 0, rayleighRate (x -> r^2 V(r x)) = r * rayleighRate V."
  1750	  keywords: [rayleigh-quotient, dilation]
  1751	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/WeakSobolev.lean
  1752	  status: reusable
  1753	# VariationalDilation
  1754	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-c-pos
  1755	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.CPos
  1756	  kind: definition
  1757	  summary: "CPos d := set of Psi : R x R^d -> R that are ContDiff R infinity, have compact support, tsupport Psi in Ioo 0 1 x univ, Psi >= 0 everywhere, Psi /= 0."
  1758	  keywords: [control-class, definition]
  1759	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1760	  status: reusable
  1761	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-dil
  1762	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.dil
  1763	  kind: definition
  1764	  summary: "dil alpha r Psi (s, x) := r^(d + 2 - alpha) * Psi(s, r x) (real power)."
  1765	  keywords: [dilation, definition]
  1766	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1767	  status: reusable
  1768	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-c-pos-nonempty
  1769	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.CPos_nonempty
  1770	  kind: theorem
  1771	  summary: "For every d, CPos d is nonempty."
  1772	  keywords: [control-class, nonempty]
  1773	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1774	  status: reusable
  1775	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-dil-maps-to
  1776	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.dil_mapsTo
  1777	  kind: theorem
  1778	  summary: "For any real alpha and r > 0, dil alpha r maps CPos d into CPos d."
  1779	  keywords: [dilation, control-class]
  1780	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1781	  status: reusable
  1782	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-dil-inv-dil
  1783	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.dil_inv_dil
  1784	  kind: theorem
  1785	  summary: "For r > 0 and every Psi : R x R^d -> R, dil alpha (1/r) (dil alpha r Psi) = Psi."
  1786	  keywords: [dilation, inverse]
  1787	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1788	  status: reusable
  1789	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-dil-dil-inv
  1790	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.dil_dil_inv
  1791	  kind: theorem
  1792	  summary: "For r > 0 and every Psi : R x R^d -> R, dil alpha r (dil alpha (1/r) Psi) = Psi."
  1793	  keywords: [dilation, inverse]
  1794	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1795	  status: reusable

1796	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-dil-bij-on
  1797	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.dil_bijOn
  1798	  kind: theorem
  1799	  summary: "For r > 0: Set.InvOn (dil alpha (1/r)) (dil alpha r) (CPos d) (CPos d) and Set.BijOn (dil alpha r) (CPos d) (CPos d)."
  1800	  keywords: [dilation, bijection]
  1801	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1802	  status: reusable
  1803	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-set-scaling
  1804	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.SetScaling
  1805	  kind: definition
  1806	  summary: "SetScaling alpha Gamma :<=> for every measurable A and c > 0, Gamma(c . A) = ENNReal.ofReal (c^(d - alpha)) * Gamma(A)."
  1807	  keywords: [homogeneous-covariance, definition]
  1808	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1809	  status: reusable
  1810	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-map-dilation
  1811	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.map_dilation
  1812	  kind: theorem
  1813	  summary: "If SetScaling alpha Gamma and r > 0, then Gamma.map (y -> r y) = ENNReal.ofReal (r^(alpha - d)) . Gamma."
  1814	  keywords: [pushforward, homogeneous-covariance]
  1815	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1816	  status: reusable
  1817	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-integral-dilation
  1818	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.integral_dilation
  1819	  kind: theorem
  1820	  summary: "If SetScaling alpha Gamma, r > 0 and G : R^d -> R is continuous, then int G(r y) dGamma(y) = r^(alpha - d) * int G dGamma."
  1821	  keywords: [pushforward, homogeneous-covariance]
  1822	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1823	  status: reusable
  1824	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-integrable-dilation-iff
  1825	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.integrable_dilation_iff
  1826	  kind: theorem
  1827	  summary: "If SetScaling alpha Gamma, r > 0 and G is continuous, then y -> G(r y) is Gamma-integrable iff G is."
  1828	  keywords: [pushforward, integrability]
  1829	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1830	  status: reusable
  1831	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-conv
  1832	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.conv
  1833	  kind: definition
  1834	  summary: "conv Gamma phi x := int phi(x - y) dGamma(y) (Bochner integral)."
  1835	  keywords: [convolution, definition]
  1836	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1837	  status: reusable
  1838	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-mean
  1839	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.mean
  1840	  kind: definition
  1841	  summary: "mean a Gamma Psi s x := int over u in Ioo 0 1 of |s - u|^(-a) * conv Gamma (y -> Psi(u, y)) x."
  1842	  keywords: [original-mean, definition]
  1843	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1844	  status: reusable
  1845	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-raw-cost
  1846	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.rawCost
  1847	  kind: definition
  1848	  summary: "rawCost a Gamma Psi := int over sigma in Ioo 0 1 of int Psi(sigma, x) * mean a Gamma Psi sigma x dx."
  1849	  keywords: [original-variance, definition]
  1850	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1851	  status: reusable
  1852	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-rate
  1853	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.rate
  1854	  kind: definition
  1855	  summary: "rate a Gamma Psi s := WeakSobolev.rayleighRate (mean a Gamma Psi s)."
  1856	  keywords: [rayleigh-rate, definition]
  1857	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1858	  status: reusable
  1859	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-integrated-rate
  1860	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.integratedRate
  1861	  kind: definition
  1862	  summary: "integratedRate a Gamma Psi := int over s in Ioo 0 1 of rate a Gamma Psi s."
  1863	  keywords: [rayleigh-rate, definition]
  1864	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1865	  status: reusable
  1866	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-amp-mul-push
  1867	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.amp_mul_push
  1868	  kind: theorem
  1869	  summary: "For r > 0, r^(d + 2 - alpha) * r^(alpha - d) = r^2."
  1870	  keywords: [real-power, dilation]
  1871	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1872	  status: internal
  1873	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-amp-variance
  1874	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.amp_variance
  1875	  kind: theorem
  1876	  summary: "For r > 0, r^(d + 2 - alpha) * r^2 * (r^d)^(-1) = r^(4 - alpha)."
  1877	  keywords: [real-power, dilation]
  1878	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1879	  status: internal
  1880	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-conv-dil
  1881	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.conv_dil
  1882	  kind: theorem
  1883	  summary: "If SetScaling alpha Gamma, r > 0 and Psi is continuous, then for all u, x: conv Gamma (y -> dil alpha r Psi (u, y)) x = r^2 * conv Gamma (y -> Psi(u, y)) (r x)."
  1884	  keywords: [convolution, dilation]
  1885	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1886	  status: reusable
  1887	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-conv-dil-integrable-iff
  1888	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.conv_dil_integrable_iff
  1889	  kind: theorem
  1890	  summary: "If SetScaling alpha Gamma, r > 0 and Psi is continuous, then for all u, x: y -> dil alpha r Psi (u, x - y) is Gamma-integrable iff y -> Psi(u, r x - y) is."
  1891	  keywords: [convolution, integrability]
  1892	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1893	  status: reusable
  1894	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-mean-dil
  1895	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.mean_dil
  1896	  kind: theorem
  1897	  summary: "If SetScaling alpha Gamma, r > 0 and Psi is continuous, then for all a, s, x: mean a Gamma (dil alpha r Psi) s x = r^2 * mean a Gamma Psi s (r x)."
  1898	  keywords: [original-mean, dilation]
  1899	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1900	  status: reusable
  1901	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-mean-dil-integrable-iff
  1902	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.mean_dil_integrable_iff
  1903	  kind: theorem
  1904	  summary: "Under SetScaling, r > 0, Psi continuous: u -> |s-u|^(-a) * conv Gamma (D_r Psi(u,.)) x is integrable on Ioo 0 1 iff u -> |s-u|^(-a) * conv Gamma (Psi(u,.)) (r x) is."
  1905	  keywords: [original-mean, integrability]
  1906	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1907	  status: reusable
  1908	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-cost-integrand-dil
  1909	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.cost_integrand_dil
  1910	  kind: theorem
  1911	  summary: "Under SetScaling, r > 0, Psi continuous: dil Psi (sigma, x) * mean (dil Psi) sigma x = (r^(d+2-alpha) r^2 (r^d)^(-1)) * (r^d * (Psi(sigma, r x) * mean Psi sigma (r x)))."
  1912	  keywords: [original-variance, dilation]
  1913	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean
  1914	  status: internal
  1915	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-dilation-cost-inner-integrable-iff
  1916	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.cost_inner_integrable_iff
  1917	  kind: theorem
  1918	  summary: "Under SetScaling, r > 0, Psi continuous: for all a, sigma, x -> dil Psi (sigma, x) * mean a Gamma (dil Psi) sigma x is integrable iff x -> Psi(sigma, x) * mean a Gamma Psi sigma x is."
  1919	  keywords: [original-variance, integrability]
